title: Software Engineering Intern - Summer 2025
eligibility: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD program in Computer Science or a related technical field.
qualification: Pursuing BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science, software engineering, or related discipline with coding proficiency in C++, Java, Python, or Go.
description: Build scalable systems, work on cutting-edge algorithms, and contribute to real-world products used by billions of users worldwide.

title: Gates Cambridge Scholarship 2025
eligibility: Citizens of any country outside the United Kingdom pursuing a full-time postgraduate degree at the University of Cambridge.
qualification: Outstanding academic record, leadership capacity, and a commitment to improving the lives of others.
description: Provides full-cost scholarships for postgraduate study in any subject available at the University of Cambridge for international scholars.

title: Junior Frontend Developer (React)
eligibility: Open to candidates worldwide with strong expertise in modern JavaScript and web technology.
qualification: Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in Web Development, proficiency in React, JavaScript (ES6+), and CSS.
description: Work remotely on WordPress.com, WooCommerce, and other core products, building scalable, modern frontend user interfaces.

title: Associate Product Manager
eligibility: Recent graduates or early-career professionals with 0-2 years of experience in product management or technology.
qualification: Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related field; strong problem-solving and communication skills.
description: Drive product vision, define feature specs, analyze user telemetry, and collaborate with cross-functional design and engineering teams.

title: CS50's Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open to anyone worldwide interested in learning computer science and foundational programming.
description: An entry-level course taught by David J. Malan that covers C, Python, SQL, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and core computer science principles.

title: Imagine Cup 2025 Global Student Contest
eligibility: Students aged 16 or older currently enrolled in an accredited high school, college, or university.
salary: Up to $100,000 USD grand prize + Azure credits
qualification: Student teams building innovative software solutions utilizing Azure AI, cloud tools, or emerging technology.
description: Microsoft's flagship global technology competition encouraging young innovators to build social impact tech solutions addressing urgent world issues.
